# integration-engine

> A claim, built so it could fail: does deepening need structure AND self-reference, multiplied? Measured from outside over 152 folds — structure alone predicts survival better than the product at every damage rate. What survives is sharper: self-reference is a purchase, and the right amount tracks the damage rate.

integration-engine is a sovereign, MIT-licensed build by Simon Gant (UK) — it runs in the browser, is free to own and fork, and is part of the AI Native Solutions estate. Source and a live page are linked below.
